title: AI-4-Dementia
summary: A collection of notebooks and links documenting AI methodologies for detecting dementia and neurodegenerative diseases from speech, language, and clinical data, including Parkinson's disease classification experiments. Several notebooks use SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality) to generate and assess synthetic tabular data for augmenting the classifier training data.
